limitations: Synthetic random weights unless --model is supplied; no language quality claim.
Shared desktop host, no CPU affinity or frequency control.
Round-visible TTFT/inter-token latency is not HTTP or per-token streaming latency.
Single-thread token scheduling; no fused GEMM, GPU, or production throughput claim.

methodology.latency: Native steady clock from simultaneous arrival before cache allocation. Tokens visible at completed grant-round boundaries for every variant. Excludes model loading, pipe/JSON/controller costs.
methodology.logical_cache: High-water complete-token KV payload measured at each forward before reclamation. Recompute has one temporary prefix. Allocated KV is retained vector payload capacity, including released paged buffers; excludes container overhead.
methodology.pairing: Fixed prompts/output budgets; exact greedy output equality across all variants, warmups and repetitions. Fresh child each run, rotated variant order. All raw results retained.
methodology.rss: Native process high-water working set on Windows; getrusage peak RSS on Linux. Includes model, allocator and harness; not attributable solely to KV.

variants.contiguous: single-thread round grants; one contiguous cache per request
variants.paged: production bounded paged Scheduler::step with owned arena
variants.serial-recompute: single-thread round grants; every prefix recomputed without persistent KV
